theorems.name: Submission.exists_density_upperSemicontinuous_of_locallyLp
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∃ d : ℝ, 0 ≤ d ∧ V.HasDensity ξ d ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 ξ, ∀ t : ℝ, V.HasDensity y t → t ≤ d + ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
